subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should HEARTBEAT.md hardening intentionally switch this workspace file to regular-file-only reads, or should the bounded read preserve symlinked regular files?
rationale: The selected helper fixes the size cap but also changes prior fs.readFile symlink behavior, and that upgrade/compatibility choice cannot be settled by CI.

options.title: Accept regular-file-only hardening
options.body: Merge the helper-based fix after maintainer review, treating symlinked and non-file HEARTBEAT.md paths as unsupported read errors that let heartbeat continue without file directives.

options.title: Preserve symlinked regular files
options.body: Ask for a bounded read implementation and regression test that still reads symlinked regular HEARTBEAT.md targets if that upgrade behavior matters.

options.title: Pause for broader file policy
options.body: Hold this PR if HEARTBEAT.md should be covered by a consistent workspace-file read policy rather than a one-off decision.

recommendation.title: Accept regular-file-only hardening
recommendation.body: Merge the helper-based fix after maintainer review, treating symlinked and non-file HEARTBEAT.md paths as unsupported read errors that let heartbeat continue without file directives.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent heartbeat runtime/docs history and current-line provenance make this the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
